script.body: Phone ko kab tak hawa mein latkaoge? FreshDcart wall holder hoon, side hooks cable sambhal lenge.
script.voiceover: Phone ko kab tak hawa mein latkaoge? FreshDcart wall holder hoon, side hooks cable sambhal lenge.
script.body_hi: Phone को कब तक हवा में लटकाओगे? FreshDcart wall holder हूँ, side hooks cable संभाल लेंगे।
script.voice_hi: Phone को कब तक हवा में लटकाओगे? FreshDcart wall holder हूँ, side hooks cable संभाल लेंगे।
script.meaning: How long will you leave your phone dangling in the air? I am a FreshDcart wall holder, the side hooks will handle the cable.
script.scenes: A teal wall holder with tiny animated eyes and mouth wobbles on a wall next to a switchboard where a phone dangles by its cable.; The holder sticks securely in place, holding a phone inside its pocket while wrapping the cable neatly around its side hooks.

research.audience: College students in hostels, PG residents, and renters with high switchboards and no side tables
research.problem: Switchboards placed high on the wall with no shelf nearby, forcing your phone to dangle dangerously by its charging cable
research.buyer_moment: Plugging your phone into the bedroom wall socket at night and realizing there is nowhere to rest it except hanging mid-air
features: Pack of 4 assorted color wall-mount holders
Made from durable ABS plastic material
Self-adhesive backing with two side cable hooks
research.people_reason: Hands clearly demonstrate peeling the adhesive, mounting it beside a socket, and slotting a phone inside

script.facts: Pack of 4 assorted color wall-mount holders; Made from durable ABS plastic material

style.label: product talks
style.brief: the PRODUCT is the speaker and talks in first person (main, mujhe, mera) to its owner, cute and a little cheeky. Line 1 = what it says on meeting the viewer, line 2 = a funny or sweet follow-up that shows what it is.
style.scene_rule: the product itself as a cute animated character with tiny eyes and a mouth, SAME shape and colours as in the reference image, bouncing and talking to the camera, no people, no text on screen.
style.voice_line: Voice: cute, playful character voice of the product itself, speaking everyday Hindi. Pronounce every word clearly and exactly as written, do not skip, merge or change any word.
style.yt_line: Vertical 10-second cute 3D animation: the product itself is a little character with tiny eyes and a mouth, same shape and colours as the reference photo, bouncing and talking to camera. Camera: slow macro push-in, cosy mood.
style.look_extra: Camera: slow macro push-in, cosy mood.
style.ad_brief: AD LEVEL = light: no pitch and no praise. The product is named or shown once, in passing, like a friend mentioning it.
style.caption_tone: Keep the caption casual: one friendly line plus one short mention of what the product is, no pitch.
style.caption_cta: Comment LINK to get the link in your DM
style.overlay: Show big, clear on-screen text captions, spelled exactly: Wall mount mobile charging, then Comment LINK.
